description: The official reference rate of the Turkish lira against a currency (USD, EUR, GBP and about 35 more) on the latest day your plan covers: lira per 1 unit, units per 1 lira, the day the rate is valid for, the change since the previous day and a ready citation. A dependable fallback when another rate feed fails. Free level: USD, EUR, GBP one day behind; Starter and Pro keys of TRY Reference Rates API: every currency, today.
